words.es: renovar / pasar a un modelo mejor
words.def: to replace something with a newer or better version
words.ex: I {upgrade} my phone every two years.

words.def: no longer modern or useful because something newer exists
words.ex: My old sat-nav feels completely {outdated} now.

words.def: useful in a practical, everyday way
words.ex: A small torch on your keyring is surprisingly {handy}.

words.def: a gadget that connects to the internet and can be controlled remotely
words.ex: A {smart device} like a speaker can answer questions and control your lights.

words.def: to use up power or energy until little or none is left
words.ex: Leaving your GPS on all day will {drain} your battery quickly.

words.def: filled with too many things, making it messy
words.ex: My desk is {cluttered} with cables and old gadgets I never use.

words.def: good enough to justify the price
words.ex: A good pair of wireless earbuds is absolutely {worth the money}.

words.def: a specific function or quality a gadget has
words.ex: The best {feature} on my smartwatch is the sleep tracker.
